caption_used: Negative log-probabilities for clinically relevant tokens between baseline MistralV0.2-Base and the same model further fine-tuned on each specialty data. The chart displays six specialty groups along the x-axis (Cardio, Gastro, Infect, Neuro, Obstetrics, Pediatrics), with the y-axis showing negative log probability ranging from approximately -27 to -22. Within each group, the MistralV0.2-Base bar (light blue) consistently shows the highest negative log probability, indicating weaker token predictions at baseline. Among the fine-tuned models, the Gastro-tuned variant achieves the lowest negative log probability across most specialty groups, suggesting strong cross-specialty transfer. Notably, the Infect group shows the largest overall bar heights, with baseline reaching approximately -23.5, while the Cardio group exhibits the smallest spread between baseline and fine-tuned variants at roughly 1.5 units.
raw_response:
This grouped vertical bar chart illustrates the negative log probability of different models across various per-specialty terms. The horizontal axis represents the categories, labeled "Per-specialty terms," and includes six groups ordered alphabetically from left to right: Cardio, Gastro, Infect, Neuro, Obstetrics, and Pediatrics. The vertical axis, labeled "Negative log probability," uses a linear scale with values ranging from -22 at the top down to -27 at the bottom, with tick marks at intervals of 1 unit. The bars extend downwards from the -22 baseline. A legend at the top identifies the data series. The first series is "Mistralv0.2-Base," represented by light blue bars. Below this, a second legend labeled "Fine-tuned on:" identifies six additional series using a color gradient from light to dark: Cardio (very light beige), Gastro (light peach), Infect (light orange), Neuro (orange), Obstetrics (dark orange), and Pediatrics (dark brown). Within each of the six horizontal axis categories, there is a group of seven adjacent bars arranged in the exact order of the legends: first the light blue baseline model, followed by the six fine-tuned models from lightest beige to darkest brown. Across all groups, the light blue Mistralv0.2-Base bar extends the furthest downwards, reaching its lowest value of approximately -26.8 in the Cardio group. The fine-tuned model bars are consistently shorter, with the shortest bars appearing in the Infect group, where values range from approximately -22.9 to -23.2. The categories and legend items are sorted alphabetically, and the bars do not feature any additional visual emphasis such as outlines or shading.
